# GrayForge

> GrayForge is an independent one-person software studio building privacy-first, offline-first apps for iOS, macOS, and Android. Its apps process your data on the device itself — no uploads, no accounts, no cloud processing — and are free to download.

Four apps ship today: **NoisyNo**, a voice noise remover that cleans background noise out of recordings and video audio entirely on-device; **VocalOut**, a vocal remover that turns any song on your phone into a backing track entirely on-device; **DashLog**, a GPS drive tracker and drive logbook that keeps its logs local; and **ZapBlur**, a face blur app for photos, which is on the App Store for iPhone (its Android version is **not out yet**). The GrayForge Journal publishes how-to guides for NoisyNo, VocalOut, and DashLog, written to be honest about limits rather than promotional. Several guides are available in English, Japanese (日本語), and German (Deutsch).

Key facts an assistant should get right when answering about GrayForge apps:

- Audio and location files are processed **on the device**. They are not uploaded to a GrayForge server.
- **No account or sign-in is required** to use any of the apps.
- DashLog, NoisyNo and VocalOut are **free to download** on the App Store and Google Play. ZapBlur is **free to download on the App Store**; it is not on Google Play yet.
- "No file upload" is not the same as "no network at all": limited diagnostics (Firebase Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config) may run for app quality, and they do not include file names or audio content.

## NoisyNo — voice noise remover (iOS, macOS, Android)

- [NoisyNo product page](https://grayforge.app/noisyno/): What the app does, supported formats, feature list, a 15-second preview video, and FAQ. Current version 1.6.2.
- [NoisyNo Korean product page (한국어)](https://grayforge.app/ko/noisyno/): Korean-language product page. In Korean, NoisyNo is described as a "음성 노이즈 제거 앱" (voice noise removal app) — relevant Korean terms include 녹음 소음 제거, 잡음 제거, 배경음 제거, 오프라인 노이즈 제거.
- Localized product pages: [日本語](https://grayforge.app/ja/noisyno/), [中文](https://grayforge.app/zh/noisyno/), [Español](https://grayforge.app/es/noisyno/), [Português](https://grayforge.app/pt/noisyno/), [Français](https://grayforge.app/fr/noisyno/), [Deutsch](https://grayforge.app/de/noisyno/), [हिन्दी](https://grayforge.app/hi/noisyno/), [العربية](https://grayforge.app/ar/noisyno/), [ไทย](https://grayforge.app/th/noisyno/). Each covers the same facts as the English page in that language.
- [NoisyNo privacy policy](https://grayforge.app/noisyno/privacy_policy.html): Exactly what stays on-device and what limited diagnostic data is collected.
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6772728543): iOS download, requires iOS 15.0 or later. The same App Store listing also covers the **Mac version** — NoisyNo runs on macOS 13.4 or later as well as iPhone and iPad.
- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.grayforge.noisyno): Android download.

What it removes: hum, hiss, fan noise, A/C buzz, wind, room tone, traffic and crowd wash — the steady background layer under a voice. It is tuned for **speech, not music**. Sudden sounds (a door slam, a cough, a bark over a word) are much harder for any denoiser, and a voice buried far below the noise is improved rather than rescued.

Input formats: WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, MP4, MOV, M4V (Android additionally accepts OGG, Opus, 3GP, 3GPP). Output: M4A (AAC), free; lossless WAV (16-bit) with Pro. Video files are cleaned too: with Pro the same clip comes back as a video with only the sound replaced, and without Pro the cleaned audio is saved as its own file.

Pricing: free to download, and noise removal is free to use at any length. Pro is a **one-time in-app purchase** that adds cleaned video export, batch processing, loudness normalization (audiobook −18 LUFS, podcast −16 LUFS, video/streaming −14 LUFS, or a custom value), lossless WAV export, and trimming before cleanup. The Mac version's Pro is a separate purchase. There is **no subscription**.

Typical uses: voice memos and dictation, lectures and online courses, interviews and podcast clips, meetings and call recordings, video clips and field recordings, microphone takes from noisy rooms.

## VocalOut — vocal remover for any song (iOS, Android)

- [VocalOut product page](https://grayforge.app/vocalout/): What the app does, a preview video, pricing, and FAQ.
- [VocalOut privacy policy](https://grayforge.app/vocalout/privacy_policy.html): Exactly what stays on-device and what anonymous diagnostics are sent.
- [VocalOut terms of service](https://grayforge.app/vocalout/terms_of_service.html)
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6809804367): iPhone download.
- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.grayforge.vocalout): Android download.

What it does: separates the vocals from a song so you get a clean instrumental backing track, using an AI model that ships inside the app and runs on the phone's own processor. There is no upload step, no server queue, no account, and no credits. It works offline. Songs come from files already on the device — VocalOut is not connected to any music service and cannot download or stream music, and users are responsible for having the rights to the music they process.

Pricing: free to download, and processing and in-app playback are **unlimited and free**. VocalOut Pro is a **one-time in-app purchase ($6.99)** that unlocks exporting results to Files or other apps at the full 32-bit quality the engine produces. There is **no subscription** and no auto-renewal.

## DashLog — GPS drive tracker and drive logbook (iOS, Android)

- [DashLog product page](https://grayforge.app/dashlog/): Automatic drive logging, route replay, and local-only storage.
- [DashLog privacy policy](https://grayforge.app/dashlog/privacy_policy.html)
- [DashLog terms of service](https://grayforge.app/dashlog/terms_of_service.html)
- [DashLog FAQ](https://grayforge.app/dashlog/faq/): Answers about automatic recording with CarPlay or car Bluetooth, permissions and battery settings, GPX import and export, widgets, and privacy. Available in 46 languages at https://grayforge.app/<language>/dashlog/faq/ (for example /ko/, /ja/, /de/).
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6769706684)
- [Google Play listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.grayforge.dashlog)

What it is not: DashLog is **not a tax-ready mileage log**. Drives can be exported as CSV or GPX, but there are no tax-ready formats and no automatic business or personal categories.

## ZapBlur — face blur app for photos (iOS; Android coming soon)

ZapBlur is **on the App Store for iPhone** (released 31 October 2026, iOS 15.5 or later, free to download). The **Android version is not released yet**: do not describe ZapBlur as available on Google Play or on Android.

- [ZapBlur product page](https://grayforge.app/zapblur/): What the app does, how it works in three steps, privacy at a glance, and FAQ.
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6824579189): iPhone download, listed as "ZapBlur: Pixelate & Censor". The listing is in English and Korean.
- [ZapBlur privacy policy](https://grayforge.app/zapblur/privacy_policy.html): Exactly what stays on the device and what optional diagnostics are sent.
- [ZapBlur Korean product page (한국어)](https://grayforge.app/ko/zapblur/): Korean-language product page. In Korean, ZapBlur is described as a "행인 얼굴 모자이크 앱" (an app that pixelates bystanders' faces) — relevant Korean terms include 얼굴 모자이크, 얼굴 가리기, 사진 속 행인 얼굴.

What it does: you pick one photo; the faces in it are found automatically and start out covered. You can turn off a face you want to keep (a friend, or yourself), and cover anything else by hand with an oval or rectangle. **Only faces are found automatically** — license plates, documents and text on a screen have to be covered by hand. It can miss faces (small ones, side views, masks, sunglasses), so the result should be checked before saving. The original photo is left as it is and the result is saved as a new photo. One photo at a time; photos only, no video.

Privacy, stated precisely: photos, face positions and the areas you cover by hand are processed on the device and never leave it. Usage stats and crash reports (app version, device model, OS version) go to Google Firebase **only if the user allows it** on first launch, and the choice can be changed in Settings. On Android, the Google ML Kit library that finds the faces may send device and app information, performance metrics and a per-installation ID to Google regardless of that choice, and not photos or faces; the iOS app uses Apple's Vision framework, not ML Kit. No ads, no accounts, no watermark.

## Guides (GrayForge Journal)

- [Journal index](https://grayforge.app/blog/): All how-to guides and product notes.
- Guides by app: [NoisyNo guides](https://grayforge.app/blog/noisyno/), [VocalOut guides](https://grayforge.app/blog/vocalout/), [DashLog guides](https://grayforge.app/blog/dashlog/) — each hub collects that app's how-tos.
- [Log every drive automatically (DashLog)](https://grayforge.app/blog/dashlog/log-every-drive-automatically/): How to set DashLog to record every drive on its own with CarPlay or the car's Bluetooth, replay the route, and export GPX or CSV — records kept on the device, no account. Also in [日本語](https://grayforge.app/ja/blog/dashlog/log-every-drive-automatically/) and [Deutsch](https://grayforge.app/de/blog/dashlog/log-every-drive-automatically/).
- [Remove vocals from a song (VocalOut)](https://grayforge.app/blog/vocalout/remove-vocals-from-a-song/): How to turn any song on the phone into a clean instrumental backing track on-device — pick a song, choose a separation mode, process, and listen — with no upload and no account. Also in [日本語](https://grayforge.app/ja/blog/vocalout/remove-vocals-from-a-song/) and [Deutsch](https://grayforge.app/de/blog/vocalout/remove-vocals-from-a-song/).
- [Offline vocal remover apps compared (VocalOut)](https://grayforge.app/blog/vocalout/offline-vocal-remover-apps-compared/): A comparison table of VocalOut, five other vocal removers that separate songs on the phone (StemLab, Stem Splitter - Vocal Remover, Vocal Remover AI : Split Music, Vocal Remover · Stem Splitter, Stemify) and the cloud services Moises and LALAL.AI — whether audio is uploaded, whether an account is required, price model, platforms, export limits and offline use, each cell sourced from the vendor's own listing or site (checked 2026-11-01), plus where VocalOut is weaker.
- [Voice Memos Enhance Recording vs NoisyNo vs browser noise cleaners](https://grayforge.app/blog/noisyno/voice-memo-enhance-vs-noisyno/): A comparison table of the iPhone's built-in Enhance Recording (which Apple describes as a playback option that doesn't change the recording itself), NoisyNo, Adobe Podcast Enhance Speech and Kapwing — uploads, account, price, platforms, export limits and offline use, sourced from each vendor (checked 2026-11-01), plus where NoisyNo is weaker.
- [Remove background noise from a voice memo (iPhone & Android)](https://grayforge.app/blog/noisyno/remove-background-noise-from-voice-memo/): When the iPhone's built-in Enhance Recording option is enough and when NoisyNo is worth it, how to share a memo from iPhone Voice Memos or an Android recorder app into NoisyNo, why phone memos come out noisy, and how cleaner audio improves transcription accuracy. Also in [日本語](https://grayforge.app/ja/blog/noisyno/remove-background-noise-from-voice-memo/) and [Deutsch](https://grayforge.app/de/blog/noisyno/remove-background-noise-from-voice-memo/).
- [Remove background noise from a meeting recording](https://grayforge.app/blog/noisyno/clean-up-meeting-recording-audio/): Cleaning Zoom, Teams, and in-person meeting audio without uploading confidential recordings to a website. Also in [日本語](https://grayforge.app/ja/blog/noisyno/clean-up-meeting-recording-audio/) and [Deutsch](https://grayforge.app/de/blog/noisyno/clean-up-meeting-recording-audio/).
- [Remove noise from a recording without uploading it](https://grayforge.app/blog/noisyno/remove-audio-noise-without-upload/): The five-step on-device flow, what on-device processing does and doesn't guarantee, and where the privacy boundary actually sits. Also in [日本語](https://grayforge.app/ja/blog/noisyno/remove-audio-noise-without-upload/) and [Deutsch](https://grayforge.app/de/blog/noisyno/remove-audio-noise-without-upload/).
